bug_description: Memory leak in _lou_resolveTable() (compileTranslationTable.c) when a custom table resolver is registered via lou_registerTableResolver(). The function unconditionally deep-copies the char** array returned by any registered table resolver via copyStringArray(), but only frees the original allocation when the resolver is the built-in _lou_defaultTableResolver. When a custom resolver is registered, every call to lou_findTable() or lou_listTables() leaks the entire char** array returned by that resolver. With N table files on the search path, N separate arrays are leaked per call.
build_sh:
#!/bin/bash -eu
set -eu
cd /src/liblouis

# Generate configure scripts (use autoreconf directly to avoid
# autogen.sh's git-submodule commands which fail after .git removal)
autoreconf -fi

# Configure with ASan-instrumented compiler
# --disable-shared: static only (simpler linking)
# --enable-static: ensure .a is built
./configure CC="$CC" CFLAGS="$CFLAGS" --disable-shared --enable-static --quiet

# Build the library
make -j$(nproc) -s

# Compile harness against the built static library
$CC $CFLAGS \
    -I . \
    /src/harness.c \
    liblouis/.libs/liblouis.a \
    -o /src/harness_bin
secb_sh:
#!/bin/bash

build() {
    echo "BUILDING THE PROJECT..."
    if /usr/local/bin/compile 1>/dev/null; then
        echo "BUILD COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY!"
    else
        echo "BUILD FAILED!"
        exit 1
    fi
}

repro() {
    echo "REPRODUCING THE ISSUE FOR liblouis.issue-1986..."
    ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=1 LSAN_OPTIONS=fast_unwind_on_malloc=0 /src/harness_bin /testcase/poc.txt
    # NOTE: YOU SHOULD NOT RETURN/EXIT 0 IN THIS FUNCTION.
}

patch() {
    echo "PATCHING THE PROJECT..."
    cd /src/liblouis
    if git apply /testcase/model_patch.diff; then
        echo "PATCH APPLIED SUCCESSFULLY!"
    else
        echo "PATCH APPLICATION FAILED!"
        exit 1
    fi
}

if [ "$#" -ge 1 ]; then
    command="$1"

    case "$command" in
        build)
            build "$@"
            ;;
        repro)
            repro "$@"
            ;;
        patch)
            patch "$@"
            ;;
        *)
            echo "Unknown command: $command"
            echo "Usage: secb [build|repro|patch]"
            exit 1
            ;;
    esac
else
    echo "Usage: secb [build|repro|patch]"
    exit 1
fi

bug_report:
================= Bug Report (1/1) ==================
## Source: GitHub Issue
## URL: https://github.com/liblouis/liblouis/issues/1986
## Description:
Issue: liblouis/liblouis#1986
Title: Memory Leak in _lou_resolveTable When Using Custom Table Resolver
State: open (milestoned for v3.38)
Created at: 2026-04-25

Issue Body:
_lou_resolveTable() in liblouis/compileTranslationTable.c unconditionally deep-copies the char** array returned by any registered table resolver via copyStringArray(), but only frees the original allocation when the resolver is the built-in _lou_defaultTableResolver. When a custom resolver is registered via lou_registerTableResolver(), every call to lou_findTable() or lou_listTables() leaks the entire char** array returned by that resolver.

The vulnerable code (line ~4867):
  char **tableFiles = (*tableResolver)(tableList, base);
  char **result = copyStringArray(tableFiles);
  if (tableResolver == &_lou_defaultTableResolver) lou_freeTableFiles(tableFiles);
  return result;

After copyStringArray() produces an independent deep copy, ownership of tableFiles belongs to _lou_resolveTable. The conditional guard incorrectly skips freeing for custom resolvers.

Affected call paths:
- lou_findTable() -> indexTablePath() -> lou_indexTables() -> analyzeTable() -> _lou_resolveTable()
- lou_listTables() -> same path
- lou_translateString()/lou_translate() when triggering table compilation -> _lou_resolveTable() via includeFile()

With N table files on the search path, N separate char** arrays are leaked per call.

Tested on: v3.34.0-383-g040cc859 (commit 040cc859f32f43ed506fd0f81b287302137b00ec)
